description: Stephanie Nguyen is a candidate for California State Assembly District 10. Currently, she is an Elk Grove City Councilmember (District 4) and Executive Director for a community-based organization in Sacramento. Stephanie has fought to bring economic opportunity, health equity and social justice to the families whose lives are impacted most by these issues.
